tests.note: No UI/native changes in this increment. An initial main-env run of research geometry tests lacked optional SciPy; all research contracts pass in the isolated environment.

api.blocker: Credential reuse/create choice and account access unresolved; observed OpenAI/Gemini environment keys absent.

decision: Retain specialized research challenger for owned-scene perception and further diagnostics; reject default, provider, poker and certified R2 promotion. Installed release unchanged.
limits: Three historical private screenshots represent two moments and a repeated preview, not independent provider sessions.
Human legibility not independently annotated; visible-ink threshold is geometric.
Observed-box IoU scoring is not precise pose/mask AP; legacy session anchors approximate rotation.
Suit coverage improves but wrong-suit decisions increase on owned verification; no poker approval.
No real provider full video, live capture-to-display, automatic layout inference, paid API benchmark or economic edge proof.
Two engine sessions share mechanics; six variants are paired difficulties, not twelve independent sessions.
Research weights remain private; AGPL/Enterprise conditions survive ONNX export.
